bio: With this concept, Tim Raue has tapped into the zeitgeist. The ambiance feels like that of a French brasserie – stylish yet cosy. Service is well-organised, friendly and attentive, and the delicious food is prepared using select ingredients. The menu changes every three months – along with the à la carte selection, there are always three set menus to choose from: La Sélection de Tim Raue, the classic Colette Classique and Menu Colette Vegan....
